latest_release.name: SumatraPDF Plus 3.7.111
latest_release.body:
# SumatraPDF Plus 3.7.111

- 搜索框与工具栏右边缘保持固定间距，避免 DOC 加载时随滚动条出现而跳动。
- “保存图像”窗口的两个旋转按钮等宽，裁切与调整尺寸按钮等宽。格式下拉框按内容定宽。

**新用户请先到 [3.7.107 发布页](https://github.com/dengxibo/sumatrapdf-plus/releases/tag/3.7.107)下载完整包，解压后用本版 EXE 替换其中的 SumatraPDF-Plus.exe。**

Keep the search field anchored while documents load and use matched widths for related image editing buttons. New users can download a complete package from [3.7.107](https://github.com/dengxibo/sumatrapdf-plus/releases/tag/3.7.107), then replace its executable with this release's EXE.
